three_underused_exact_results.title: One-port cubic-response physical-coordinate reconstruction
three_underused_exact_results.status: source_derived_unreviewed; physical acquisition, independent correctness, priority, and practical advantage UNKNOWN
three_underused_exact_results.claim_and_quantifiers: For xdot=-Kx-diag(alpha)x^3+e1*u, y=x1, with real symmetric SPD K, positive nodewise alpha_i, and known dimension, assume K has simple eigenvalues, nonzero port modal overlaps, and hidden beta_i=alpha_i*K_i1^2 that are nonzero and pairwise distinct. The exact H1/H3 contraction B(s,t)=sum(i>1) beta_i*q_i(s)*q_i(t), q(s)=(sI+K)^-1*e1, yields a symmetric modal-basis matrix whose eigenvectors recover physical coordinates up to hidden signed permutation.
three_underused_exact_results.physical_interface_gate: Requires exact linear response H1 and cubic Volterra H3 from a known zero-initial model with one driven/measured coordinate. Source uses a high-opposite-frequency limit or finite-R extrapolation; high-frequency noise, calibration, reset/time, inverse conditioning, and comparison against parallel Wiener-Hammerstein recovery remain open at G-CL-N596.
three_underused_exact_results.failure_scope: Zero direct port coupling, repeated hidden beta values, repeated K eigenvalues, or zero modal overlap defeat this recovery step only; the next route N598 bounds finite-noise acquisition in weak coupling.

three_underused_exact_results.title: Conditional conductive-powder closed-void certificate
three_underused_exact_results.status: source_derived_unreviewed; no acquired certificate, instrument, yield, or industrial advantage
three_underused_exact_results.claim_and_quantifiers: For a bounded connected C^(1,beta) conductor in R^3, 0<beta<1, filling only electrically shielded closed cavities, with alpha=epsilon0*M the free-space static SI polarizability and one known homogeneous material of density rho, R=Tr(alpha)/m >= 9*epsilon0/[rho*(1-phi)] and phi <= 1-9*epsilon0/[rho*R]. A covered upper measurement R<=R_U certifies phi<=phi_* when R_U<=9*epsilon0/[rho*(1-phi_*)]. Robust version also assumes per-particle rho<=rho_max, nonmetal fraction<=eta_max, response >=(1-epsilon_alpha) of the PEC response, and correctly covered R_U.
three_underused_exact_results.physical_interface_gate: G-DW-POWDER-ACQUISITION requires per-particle coverage/calibration, material/coating premises, and independent void ground truth; it further requires bounds for orientation, phase, finite electrodes, charge, neighbours and response, then useful dense-particle accepted yield. Signed force projection assumes a fixed configuration, free-space linear electrostatics and exactly affine fields; resolved signed responses and a separate sorting actuator are required.
three_underused_exact_results.failure_scope: Large response does not imply a void; one-sided certificate excludes open pores, disconnected pieces, unknown inclusions and printed-part integrity. Exact off-centre spherical-shell counterfamily rules out the specified universal positive-force nuisance cancellation; equal four-sign exposure cancels the desired mean signal.

scientific_power_primary_result.claim: Conditional information lower bound for distinguishing opposite-curvature scalar quartic potentials under full path observation, exact reset, equal known thermal noise/mobility, and a common bounded adaptive gain/force policy.
scientific_power_primary_result.exact_model: U_s(y)=b*y^4/4+gamma*y^2/2 and U_u(y)=b*y^4/4-gamma*y^2/2, b,gamma,mu,beta>0; dY=mu[(g_t+theta*gamma)Y-bY^3+f_t]dt+sqrt(2*mu/beta)dW, theta=-1/+1, |g_t|<=G, |f_t|<=F, same label-independent admissible causal randomized policy with unique nonexplosive law, Y(0)=0.
scientific_power_primary_result.quantified_result: For any eta>0, C=G+gamma+eta/2, H=1/beta+F^2/(2*eta), s*=[C+sqrt(C^2+4*b*H)]/(2*b); KL(P_u[0,T]||P_s[0,T])<=mu*beta*gamma^2*T*s*. Per-hypothesis errors <=delta<1/2 require T>=(1-2*delta)*log((1-delta)/delta)/(mu*beta*gamma^2*s*)=Omega(sqrt(b)) with fixed positive mu,beta,gamma and fixed finite G,F,eta. The deterministic total-cap result covers finite exact-reset trials with later policies adapted to earlier records.
scientific_power_primary_result.status_and_scope: Internal derivation plus same-team analytic audit; no specimen, physical interface, external proof review, or historical priority established. Does not cover unbounded control, force-at-clamp readout, different temperature/mobility/noise, direct force-law observation, or an unqualified expected stopping time.
